steps.eval: const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); const state = rt.getEngineState(); if (state.lastMessageId !== 2 || state.blackboard.values.found_map !== true) throw new Error(`the three lines were not consumed: last=${state.lastMessageId} values=${JSON.stringify(state.blackboard.values)}`); const summary = await rt.syncWorldInfo(); const book = rt.getSnapshot().memory.wiBook; if (!book?.name) throw new Error(`the memory mirror made no book for this chat (memory disabled install-wide?), so the unbind half cannot be checked: ${JSON.stringify(summary)}`); if (ctx.chatMetadata.world_info !== book.name) throw new Error(`the mirror book ${book.name} is not bound to the parent's slot (${ctx.chatMetadata.world_info})`); for (let i = 0; i < 120 && rt.getSnapshot().saveHealth?.pendingBoundary != null; i += 1) await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 100)); globalThis.__v24Parent = { chatId: ctx.chatId, integrity: ctx.chatMetadata.integrity ?? null, book: book.name, boundary: state.boundary }; return globalThis.__v24Parent;

const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); const parent = globalThis.__v24Parent; const meta = ctx.chatMetadata; if (ctx.chatId === parent.chatId) throw new Error('the page is still on the parent after opening the checkpoint'); if (ctx.chat.length !== 2) throw new Error(`the checkpoint at message 1 should hold 2 messages, it holds ${ctx.chat.length}`); if (meta.main_chat !== parent.chatId) throw new Error(`H2: main_chat is ${JSON.stringify(meta.main_chat)}, expected the parent ${parent.chatId}`); if (!meta.integrity || meta.integrity === parent.integrity) throw new Error(`H2: the checkpoint integrity is not fresh (${meta.integrity} vs parent ${parent.integrity})`); if (meta.story_orchestrator?.chatId !== parent.chatId) throw new Error(`H2: our blob should arrive stamped for the parent, it says ${JSON.stringify(meta.story_orchestrator?.chatId)}`); globalThis.__v24Branch = { chatId: ctx.chatId }; return { checkpoint: ctx.chatId, main_chat: meta.main_chat, integrity: meta.integrity, blobStampedFor: meta.story_orchestrator.chatId, slot: meta.world_info ?? null, storyLoaded: globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.getSnapshot().storyId ?? null };

const parent = globalThis.__v24Parent; const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; for (let i = 0; i < 50; i += 1) { if (SillyTavern.getContext().chatMetadata.world_info !== parent.book) break; await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 100)); } const slot = SillyTavern.getContext().chatMetadata.world_info ?? null; if (slot === parent.book) throw new Error(`the unadopted checkpoint still binds the parent's mirror book ${parent.book} in its chat lorebook slot, so the parent's memory fires in it (plan 02 section 5: unbindChatLorebook while unadopted)`); if (rt.getSnapshot().storyId && rt.getSnapshot().chatIdentity?.kind !== 'branch') throw new Error(`the checkpoint was adopted on its own (storyId ${rt.getSnapshot().storyId}); D3 says it must wait for Continue from here`); return { slot, chatIdentity: rt.getSnapshot().chatIdentity ?? null };

const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); const branch = globalThis.__v24Branch.chatId; const blob = ctx.chatMetadata.story_orchestrator; if (blob?.chatId !== branch) throw new Error(`after Continue the blob is still stamped for ${JSON.stringify(blob?.chatId)}, not the checkpoint`); if (blob.integrity !== ctx.chatMetadata.integrity) throw new Error(`after Continue the blob integrity ${JSON.stringify(blob.integrity)} is not the checkpoint's ${ctx.chatMetadata.integrity}`); await rt.syncWorldInfo(); const book = rt.getSnapshot().memory.wiBook; if (!book?.name || book.chatId !== branch || !book.name.endsWith(` - ${branch}`)) throw new Error(`the checkpoint did not get its own mirror book: ${JSON.stringify(book)}`); if (ctx.chatMetadata.world_info !== book.name) throw new Error(`the checkpoint's slot names ${ctx.chatMetadata.world_info}, not its own book ${book.name}`); const parent = globalThis.__v24Parent; const data = await fetch('/api/chats/group/get', { method: 'POST', headers: ctx.getRequestHeaders(), body: JSON.stringify({ id: parent.chatId }) }).then((r) => r.json()); const parentBlob = Array.isArray(data) ? data[0]?.chat_metadata?.story_orchestrator : null; if (parentBlob?.chatId !== parent.chatId) throw new Error(`Continue touched the parent's blob: ${JSON.stringify(parentBlob?.chatId)}`); return { checkpointBook: book.name, parentBlob: parentBlob.chatId };
